title: Version 1.52.0
html:
Version 1.52.0

March 15th, 2024

Added:

  • The magma cave has been completely revamped!
  • A new rock called Flameslate is added, and can be found in the new magma cave
  • Added a brand new store, with 5 new items! Good luck figuring out what they are
  • Four new tools have been added: Reinforced Axe, Pickaxe, Saw, and Chisel!
  • Prismarine has been added to the game, it is found in the river caves and replaces Lightslate
  • Incoming meteors now provide notification warnings for a better heads up!
  • A spruce tree has been added to the grasslands
  • Jak and Inverted are now in the developer credits, I guess they weren't developers before.. free labor!!!
  • A new progression system was added, resulting in some materials having a power requirement. Different tools and machines give different power!

Changes:

  • Lumite no-longer spawns in Lightslate, old Lightslate is replaced with Prismarine. Sorry collectors
  • Revamped the Uncertain Pickaxe model, thank you Peekaboo and Aylien!
  • Removed 'tall' prefix from all tools (ex: Tall Refined Axe -> Refined Axe). That's right, you're short now. Sorry.
  • Updated bounding box for Emotional Gift, Anniversary cake, and the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty.
  • The Oak Depot window characters now have hard hats, because y'know, they needed that extra safety in their glass container

Fixes:

  • The Number Combiner and Number Splitter now have correct descriptions
  • The Confetti Launcher now shoots confetti again, allowing for more fun times!
  • Fixed Konami not affecting drag outline
  • The mysterious snow particles appearing on a beach should be gone. No more upset snow cloud, don't worry, therapy works!
  • The classic store should no longer have a blank item spot every time
  • Many other misc fixes we forgot to note down.. oops...
  • Alignment conveyor teleportation exploits no longer work
  • Stacking sanders to combine their output should no longer work

Version 1.52.1

March 15th, 2024

Added:

  • An Apple Pi has appeared in the Oak Depot for a late Pi day. It will go away in 7 days (March 22) and return next year!

Changes:

  • Further adjusted store prices to be more fair
  • Buffed magma by a bit to make it more worthwile (120 -> 150 per stud)
  • Buffed Reinforced Axe hit power (0.625 -> 0.8)
  • Buffed the sell price of flameslate by 2x
  • Adjusted the magma cave platforms to be larger in width, allowing easier travel
  • Increased spawn rate of Lumite
  • Spruce trees now can spawn in the Highlands region

Version 1.52.2

March 29th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Fixed possible duplication method
  • Fixed trailers not being able to have a specific grey color
